domain.description: The domain id, the folder name.

owner.description: Role that gets flags and held triggers, and owns triggered cases by default.

regulated.description: Regulated mode: e-signatures, required reasons, audit export.

qa.description: Regulated domains: the role whose signature makes a change request live (QA). Default the owner.

retention.description: How long records are kept, e.g. 25y.

accepts_from.description: Domains whose workflows may start or call this domain's workflows.

intake.description: Incoming messages to this address start the domain's message triggers.

home.description: The domain's home: a question box. Asking opens a chat with a draft record beside it; recent drafts and the records being worked on are listed under the box.

ask.description: The heading above the question box, e.g. "What does the literature say?".

placeholder.description: The hint inside the question box.

entity.description: The entity a question becomes a draft of (a bare name in this domain), e.g. Topic. It needs a lifecycle.

question.description: The draft's Text field the question goes into.

name.description: The draft's Text field for a short name; the chat writes a better one.

page.description: The draft's Text field the chat writes its page into (markdown, laid out for the question, with chart blocks).

title: MemWise domain
description: domains/<id>/domain.yaml (or domain/domain.yaml for the default domain).
